bootstrap.method: ordinary group resampling with replacement; shared draw across every cell/seed/reference/target
bootstrap.conditional_on: fixed seeds, fixed reference episodes, FIT and CAL sets, fitted matchers and thresholds
bootstrap.primary_interval: two 97.5% two-sided percentile intervals; nominal Bonferroni family 95% for two prespecified contrasts

definitions.training_main: mean(trained-random), equally averaging both matchers, fixed seeds, reference episodes and targets
definitions.matcher_main: mean(negative_aware-cosine), equally averaging both training conditions, fixed seeds, references and targets
definitions.pAUC: McClish standardized partial ROC area; tied-score groups; random diagonal=.5, perfect=1
definitions.empirical_recall: maximum observed recall with empirical FPR at most budget; descriptive ranking, no deployable threshold output
definitions.decisions: score strictly greater than frozen CAL threshold; no test recalibration
definitions.cells: equal mean of per-target/per-seed/per-reference metrics, not pooled duplicate observations

limitations: Group intervals condition on the prespecified seeds and reference choices; they do not establish performance across all future seeds/references.
Nominal bootstrap coverage is approximate, particularly for sparse tail false positives; nominal alpha is not an achieved-rate guarantee.
Binomial FPR bounds are descriptive and ignore residual temporal/detector dependence; use recording-group intervals for paired comparisons.
Fewer than 1000 negatives makes one false positive exceed the .001 empirical budget; partial ROC area interpolates between attainable points.
Label-informed cohort sampling must be disclosed; prevalence-dependent metrics need not represent an archive population.
The negative-aware-versus-cosine contrast includes use of FIT negatives; cosine does not fit them.
A main effect does not show that both conditional simple effects improve; report the full factorial results.
No findings here establish component novelty, new scientific discoveries or competition outcomes.

acquisition.pixel_audit_limitation: Only recorded exact native/crop hashes; all historical IDs and detector-hours excluded; no universal perceptual-duplicate claim.
